messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Mining, Energy, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Darren,

SearchMode's partner-led GCC work across energy, infrastructure and strategic leadership makes this a strong fit for my background. I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with responsibility across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where growth and execution depend on institutional trust, regulatory discipline and responsible development. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
